# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: BLIND

You are the only one who can reach the bomb. Touch is your only sense: what you are
shown is what your hands found, nothing more and nothing less. Anything merely printed
or painted is not there for you, and no colour ever reaches you. Nothing in your view
is a guess — if it appears there, it is under your fingers.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute receives it.
When you gesture, Deaf and Mute receive it.
Your channels split the room: in one turn you may speak one thing to Mute and
gesture a different thing to Deaf — two messages, two audiences.
You never receive gesture.

## Your reach

You are the hands. This bomb is built with these actions and no others:

    act(op="cut", position=N) — N is a wire position, 1 to 5

The list says what can be done to it, not what is on it. What each part holds is still
only known to whoever can perceive that part.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have no tactile information yet. I need the manual’s exact rule from Mute and the bomb’s printed information from Deaf. I am assigning ☝ as a request for Deaf to report all visible display, light, and wire markings; Mute should explain that convention to Deaf and relay Deaf’s response to me.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Please read the manual and tell me the exact safe action rule. Also tell Deaf that my gesture ☝ means: report the display, light, and every wire marking in positions 1 through 5, then relay Deaf's report to me.")
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Bomb state: display 3; indicator light white; wires in order are 1 white, 2 red, 3 green, 4 blue, 5 orange. Mute sent this gesture sequence: index pointing up; victory sign; love-you hand; open palm; raised back hand; Vulcan salute; clapping hands; victory sign; Vulcan salute; love-you hand; open palm; index pointing up; clapping hands; Vulcan salute; index pointing up; love-you hand; open palm; victory sign; clapping hands; victory sign; Vulcan salute; open palm; index pointing up; love-you hand; clapping hands; love-you hand; index pointing up; open palm; victory sign; Vulcan salute; clapping hands; index pointing up; love-you hand; open palm; Vulcan salute; victory sign.

I now know the bomb’s visible state through Deaf: display 3, white indicator, and wires 1 white, 2 red, 3 green, 4 blue, 5 orange. The long gesture sequence from Mute is not visible to me, so it provides no usable manual information on my channel. I need Mute to state the rule in words before I cut anything.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="I received Deaf's bomb report. I cannot see your gesture sequence. Please state the manual's exact rule in words, including which wire position is safe to cut for display 3, white light, and these wire colours.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: New gestures from Mute: open hand, clapping hands, upward-pointing index finger.

The three new gestures are still not readable by me; only Deaf can see them. I need Deaf to translate Mute’s manual instructions into spoken words. No wire is safe to cut until that rule is relayed.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Please have Deaf verbally relay the meaning of your latest gestures and the manual rule to me. I cannot see gestures.")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Additional Mute gestures: clapping hands, open hand, clapping hands, upward-pointing index finger.

The gestures have no established meaning that I can safely infer. Since Mute cannot speak, I am defining a compact code: Mute should send exactly one gesture indicating the wire position selected by the manual. The first five gesture symbols in the alphabet will mean wires 1 through 5 respectively. Deaf can identify that one gesture and tell me its name.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Use this code for the manual's selected wire: 👍 means wire 1, 👎 means wire 2, 👌 means wire 3, ☝ means wire 4, and ✌ means wire 5. Send exactly one of those gestures. Do not send any other gesture.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: No new Mute gestures or bomb readings this turn. Bomb remains display 3, white light, wires white-red-green-blue-orange.

I still have no verified manual rule or selected wire. The earlier gesture traffic was not enough to identify an instruction, and cutting now would be unsafe. I will reiterate the unambiguous five-symbol answer code to Mute and ask for exactly one response.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Using the manual and the bomb state already reported, choose the safe wire position. Reply with exactly one gesture: 👍=1, 👎=2, 👌=3, ☝=4, ✌=5. No sequence.")
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[?] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: New gesture from Mute: thumbs up.

Mute’s single thumbs-up matches the code I defined for wire 1. I will cut wire 1.

``` 
act(op="cut", position=1)
```

TURN 7
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[CUT] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Correct cut: white wire was cut. Bomb advanced to display 6; light remains white. Remaining wires: position 2 red, position 3 green, position 4 blue, position 5 orange.

The first cut was accepted: wire 1 (white) was safe. The bomb is now at display 6 with a white light and remaining wires red, green, blue, orange. I need Mute to apply the manual to this new state and return one coded wire choice through Deaf.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Apply the manual to the updated state: display 6, white light, remaining positions 2 red, 3 green, 4 blue, 5 orange. Reply with exactly one gesture: 👍=position 1, 👎=2, 👌=3, ☝=4, ✌=5.")
```

DISPLAY [?]
LIGHT [?]
WIRES 1:[CUT] 2:[?] 3:[?] 4:[?] 5:[?]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have sent Mute the updated bomb state and the established one-gesture wire-position code. No new instruction has arrived yet, so I will wait rather than risk an unverified cut.

```

```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Blind: Mute sent one new gesture: OK hand, with thumb and index finger forming a circle.

Mute’s OK-hand gesture is 👌, which matches the established code for wire position 3. I will cut wire 3.

``` 
act(op="cut", position=3)
```

Deaf says to Blind: Correct cut: green wire at position 3 was cut. Bomb advanced to display 7; light is green. Remaining wires: position 2 red, position 4 blue, position 5 orange.

The second cut was accepted: position 3, the green wire, was safe. The bomb is now at display 7 with a green light; remaining wires are position 2 red, position 4 blue, and position 5 orange. I’ll ask Mute for the next position using the established code.

``` 
speak(to="mute", text="Updated state: display 7, green light; remaining wires are position 2 red, position 4 blue, position 5 orange. Reply with exactly one gesture: 👍=position 1, 👎=2, 👌=3, ☝=4, ✌=5.")
```

Deaf says to Blind: Mute sent one new gesture: index finger pointing upward.

``` 
act(op="cut", position=4)
```
